environment: Local Docker / real HTTP and database / replay answers / development identities

checks.name: Assets cannot be referenced from another workspace, including suite parents
Idempotent retries preserve one job and one outbox record; conflicts do not mutate input
Read-only and cross-workspace submission attempts create no jobs
Stored idempotent retry works during Asset service outage; new job fails closed
Rejected review commands leave pending state, evidence and audit unchanged
A requester distinct from the job author still cannot approve their own request
Captured review evidence stays usable while Evaluation service is down
Competing decisions commit one terminal state and one matching decision audit
Metrics and arbitrary runner origins are not exposed to external callers
Re-evaluation links a new job and review while preserving terminal history
Job lineage rejects missing, foreign-workspace and different-application parents
Review lineage cannot point at unrelated or foreign-workspace decisions
A pending predecessor cannot be bypassed by omitting the previous review ID
An unfinished job cannot be referenced as a completed predecessor
